modules.title: Data Privacy
modules.purpose: To ensure Sales & Events Executives handle guest and employee personal data securely and in compliance with Aurelle Hotels & Residences data privacy policies.
key_concepts: Prohibition of personal devices and USB drives
assessment_topics: Data Privacy Compliance for Sales & Events
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete Guest Data Privacy training within Week 1, achieve at least 80% on the quiz, and complete all assigned tasks and checklist items.

content.text: Apply data protection principles regarding guest personal data access, identity document scanning, retention limits, and secure communication.
Comply with employee file access restrictions and properly report any suspected data security incidents.

content.activity: Complete Guest Data Privacy training

content.description: Perform a compliance audit of temporary digital folders to ensure no guest identity documents or personal data have been copied to local USB drives, shared network drives, or personal cloud storage.
content.expected_outcome: Confirmation that all stored data adheres to authorized PMS and HR system boundaries without unauthorized external copies.
content.completion_criteria: Submit an audit checklist verifying zero unauthorized copies on removable media or personal cloud storage.

content.situation: A corporate client calls the sales office asking for the room number of a VIP executive attending an event, and a visitor arrives at the desk asking if a specific guest is currently checked in.
expected_actions: Do not disclose the room number or guest name to the caller or visitor.
Connect incoming calls directly to the room without confirming the guest's presence.

content.question: When is Guest Data Privacy training required to be completed for roles involving guest personal data?
content.explanation: Employees whose role involves guest personal data must complete Guest Data Privacy training within their first week.

content.question: Guest personal data may be accessed for any general business inquiry across different departments.
content.explanation: Guest personal data may only be accessed to deliver the guest's stay or for a documented business need.

options: Only into the PMS, while paper copies are prohibited
Into a secure local folder on your computer desktop
Onto a shared network drive for department access
Into a personal mobile messaging app
content.question: Where is it permissible to scan a guest's passport or national ID?
content.explanation: A guest's passport or national ID may be scanned only into the PMS; paper copies are prohibited.

content.question: What is the maximum retention period for scanned copies of guest identity documents in the PMS?
content.explanation: Scanned copies of guest identity documents must be permanently deleted from the PMS no later than 7 days after check-out.

content.question: Within what timeframe must any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data be reported to the Duty Manager and IT?
content.explanation: Any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data must be reported to the Duty Manager and IT within 1 hour of discovery.

content.question: Employee personal files may be stored in shared drives for easy team access.
content.explanation: Employee personal files must be accessed only by Human Resources and stored in the HR system, never in shared drives.

content.topic: Data Privacy Compliance for Sales & Events

rubric.criterion: Understanding of Data Access and Retention Rules
rubric.pass_condition: Achieves full marks on access and retention scenario questions.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies purpose limitation, PMS scanning constraints, and the 7-day post-checkout deletion timeline.

rubric.pass_condition: Accurately identifies reporting channels and prohibited storage methods.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates knowledge of the 1-hour incident reporting window and prohibitions against personal device storage and USB copying.

modules.title: Fire & Life Safety and 2 related areas
modules.purpose: To ensure new employees understand fire and life safety protocols, IT access standards, and employee handbook guidelines on their first day and ongoing.
assessment_topics: Fire Safety and Onboarding Compliance Verification
modules.completion_criteria: Completion of all mandatory Day 1 checklists, tasks, and achieving a passing grade on the assessment.

content.text: Identify fire and life safety orientation, assembly point, exit locations, and the RACE procedure without lift usage.
Acknowledge the Employee Handbook and maintain proper staff ID badge display while adhering to PMS access limits.

content.activity: Complete Fire and Life Safety orientation on Day 1
Locate fire assembly point and two nearest fire exits for work area
Read the Employee Handbook and sign the acknowledgement form on first working day
Collect staff ID badge from Human Resources on Day 1
Complete the Aurelle Culture e-learning path within first 30 days

content.description: Locate and map out the two nearest fire exits and the fire assembly point for your sales and events work area.
content.expected_outcome: Clear personal familiarity with escape routes from the work area.
content.completion_criteria: Successfully walk the route to the fire assembly point and identify both nearest exits.

content.situation: You hear the fire alarm sound while working in your office. Your colleague suggests taking the elevator to reach the ground floor quickly.
expected_actions: Follow the RACE procedure (Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate)
Proceed to the fire assembly point using the stairs

content.question: When must the Fire and Life Safety orientation be completed?
content.explanation: Fire and Life Safety orientation must be completed on Day 1.

content.question: Employees are permitted to use the lifts when hearing the fire alarm if they are in a hurry.
content.explanation: On hearing the fire alarm, employees must follow the RACE procedure (Rescue, Alarm, Contain, Evacuate) and must not use the lifts.

content.question: How often must all employees participate in a fire drill?
content.explanation: All employees must participate in a fire drill every six months.

content.question: When must you read the Employee Handbook and sign the acknowledgement form?
content.explanation: All employees must read the Employee Handbook and sign the acknowledgement form on their first working day.

options: From your department head on Day 3
From IT on your first week
content.question: When and where must you collect your staff ID badge?
content.explanation: Employees must collect their staff ID badge from Human Resources on Day 1 and wear it visibly at all times while on property.

options: Associates can request any access level they prefer
Access levels are assigned by role, and associates must not request or use a higher level than required
All sales executives have unrestricted superuser access
Access levels can be shared between team members
content.question: Which of the following applies to PMS access levels?
content.explanation: PMS access levels are assigned by role; associates must not request or use a higher access level than their role requires.

content.topic: Fire Safety and Onboarding Compliance Verification

rubric.pass_condition: Completed on Day 1 without delay.
rubric.expected_performance: Attends Day 1 FLS orientation and submits signed handbook acknowledgement form.

rubric.criterion: Work Area Exit and Assembly Point Knowledge
rubric.pass_condition: Demonstrated accurately during physical check.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies the two nearest fire exits and assembly point for work area.

rubric.pass_condition: Compliant with badge policy and role access restrictions.
rubric.expected_performance: Wears staff ID badge visibly and adheres to assigned PMS access level rules.

modules.title: HR Operations
modules.purpose: To equip employees with essential knowledge regarding Aurelle Hotels & Residences HR policies, working hours, attendance procedures, leave entitlements, grievances, and workplace guidelines.
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all required checklist items, practical tasks, and pass the knowledge assessment covering HR operations and leave policies.

content.text: Understand probation requirements, standard working hours, attendance procedures, and grievance escalation steps.
Master leave entitlements, accrual rules, request timelines, blackout dates, and sick leave medical certification policies.
Comply with illness reporting procedures, internal transfer eligibility rules, and uniform laundering guidelines.

content.activity: Acknowledge probation period terms and formal review schedule
Complete and record the 30-day check-in meeting with reporting manager in the HR portal
Acknowledge standard working hours and overtime pre-approval rules
Acknowledge illness absence reporting procedure
Acknowledge workplace grievance escalation procedure
Acknowledge annual leave entitlement and monthly accrual rules
Acknowledge annual leave carry-forward limits and lapse dates
Acknowledge annual leave request submission lead time requirements
Acknowledge property blackout dates restrictions for annual leave
Acknowledge sick leave medical certificate submission rules
Acknowledge staff entrance and biometric clock attendance recording rules
Acknowledge uniform room laundering policies

content.description: Log your attendance via the biometric clock at the staff entrance and verify your first shift record.
content.expected_outcome: Attendance correctly captured on the biometric clock system.
content.completion_criteria: Biometric record successfully verified by reporting manager.

content.situation: You need to request annual leave for a family vacation starting 20 days from now, but you notice your dates overlap with a published property blackout period.
expected_actions: Recognize that annual leave will not be approved during property blackout dates except in documented emergencies.
Reschedule your leave outside of blackout dates or obtain emergency documentation if applicable before submitting through the HR portal at least 14 days in advance.

options: Three-month probation with reviews at months one and two
Six-month probation with formal reviews at the end of months one, three and five
One-year probation with reviews every six months
Six-month probation with a single review at month six
content.question: What is the duration of the probation period for new employees, and when do formal reviews take place?
content.explanation: New employees must complete a six-month probation period, with formal reviews at the end of months one, three and five.

options: 24 calendar days, accrued yearly on January 1st
30 calendar days, accrued monthly from the date of joining
21 calendar days, accrued monthly after probation
content.question: How many days of annual leave are employees entitled to per year, and how do they accrue?
content.explanation: Employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of annual leave per year, accrued monthly from the date of joining.

content.question: Any number of unused annual leave days can be carried forward to the next year without restriction.
content.explanation: A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year; any excess days lapse on 31 March.

options: Submitted immediately before taking the leave
Submitted within 24 hours of starting the leave
Submitted by the end of the calendar month
content.question: When must sick leave of more than two consecutive days be supported by a medical certificate?
content.explanation: Sick leave of more than two consecutive days must be supported by a medical certificate submitted within 48 hours of return.

options: Wash uniforms at home using mild detergent
Drop uniforms off at local external dry cleaners
Return uniforms to the Uniform Room for laundering; washing at home is not permitted
Wash uniforms in guest laundry facilities on property
content.question: What is the correct procedure for uniform cleaning according to company policy?
content.explanation: Uniforms must be returned to the Uniform Room for laundering; washing uniforms at home is not permitted.

options: Escalate immediately to the General Manager on the same day
Escalate in writing to Human Resources if unresolved within five working days
File a formal legal complaint after 30 days
Wait until the annual performance review to discuss it
content.question: If a workplace grievance is unresolved with your direct supervisor, what is the required next step and timeline?
content.explanation: Grievances must be raised first with the direct supervisor and, if unresolved within five working days, escalated in writing to Human Resources.

rubric.criterion: Comprehension of Attendance and Working Hours
rubric.pass_condition: Demonstrates full knowledge of attendance protocols without error.
rubric.expected_performance: Accurately explains standard working hours, biometric clock-in procedures, and illness reporting timelines.

rubric.criterion: Mastery of Leave and Absence Policies
rubric.pass_condition: Correctly answers leave policy scenarios and rules.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates understanding of annual leave accrual, carry-forward limits, notice periods, blackout dates, and sick leave medical certificates.

rubric.criterion: Understanding of HR Operations and Grievance Procedures
rubric.pass_condition: Successfully articulates escalation paths and operational rules.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies probation review schedules, grievance escalation timelines, and uniform care rules.

modules.title: Information Security
modules.purpose: To ensure all employees understand and apply Aurelle Hotels & Residences information security standards, password requirements, multi-factor authentication rules, and proper incident reporting procedures.
key_concepts: Mobile Device Management and acceptable use
assessment_topics: Information Security Policies, Access Controls, and Incident Reporting
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all tasks, achieve at least 80% on the quiz, complete the e-learning module, and acknowledge the Information Security Policy.

content.text: Complete mandatory information security e-learning and acknowledge the Information Security Policy within the designated timeframe.
Apply correct password standards, multi-factor authentication, account sharing prohibitions, workstation locking, and device connection rules.
Identify and appropriately report phishing emails, security incidents, and adhere to acceptable business use policies.

content.activity: Acknowledge the Information Security Policy in the HR portal

content.description: Complete the Information Security Basics e-learning module and ensure MFA is enabled for your email and PMS.
content.expected_outcome: E-learning completed and MFA active on required systems, permitting system access request submission by line manager.
content.completion_criteria: E-learning completion certificate generated and MFA verified active on email and PMS.

content.situation: You receive an email that looks suspicious, requesting urgent verification of event booking credentials. Concurrently, you notice an unusual login alert on your account.
expected_actions: Use the Report Phishing button on the suspicious email and do not forward it to colleagues.
Report the suspected security incident to the IT Service Desk immediately.
Change your password immediately if compromise is suspected.

content.question: What is the minimum required length for passwords under Aurelle information security standards?
content.explanation: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and must be changed immediately if compromise is suspected.

content.question: Multi-factor authentication must be enabled for email and for the Property Management System (PMS) before first use.
content.explanation: Multi-factor authentication must be enabled for email and for the Property Management System (PMS) before first use.

options: Forward it to your colleagues to warn them.
Report it using the Report Phishing button.
Reply to the sender asking for clarification.
content.question: How should you handle a suspected phishing email?
content.explanation: Suspected phishing emails must be reported using the Report Phishing button and must not be forwarded to colleagues.

options: Leave the screen open since you will only be gone for a few minutes.
Ask a colleague to watch your desk.
content.question: You need to step away from your computer at your desk in the Sales & Events office to attend a quick meeting in the lobby. What must you do?
content.explanation: Workstations must be locked whenever they are left unattended.

options: Enrolment in the Mobile Device Management app
Installation of the Property Management System
A written request submitted one week in advance
content.question: What is required before connecting a personal device to the staff Wi-Fi?
content.explanation: Personal devices must not be connected to the staff Wi-Fi without enrolment in the Mobile Device Management app.

content.question: Users are permitted to share login credentials with temporary team members as long as every action in the PMS is tracked.
content.explanation: Users must never share login credentials; every action in the PMS must be performed under the user's own account.

content.topic: Information Security Policies, Access Controls, and Incident Reporting

rubric.pass_condition: Completed within the first week (W1/D1).
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates timely completion of Information Security Basics e-learning and HR policy acknowledgment.

rubric.pass_condition: All scenario and quiz questions regarding access control answered correctly.
rubric.expected_performance: Accurately applies password rules, MFA setup, workstation locking, and account non-sharing guidelines.

rubric.pass_condition: Identifies use of Report Phishing button and IT Service Desk reporting.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies reporting mechanisms for phishing emails and security incidents.

modules.title: Revenue Management and Incident Escalation
modules.purpose: To equip the Sales & Events Executive with the necessary standards regarding loaded rates, rate overrides, late check-out waivers, and incident reporting and escalation procedures at Aurelle Hotels & Residences.
assessment_topics: Revenue Management and Incident Escalation Policies
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all checklist items, tasks, and pass the knowledge assessment with a minimum score corresponding to rubric requirements.

content.text: Comply with loaded rate policies and handle rate overrides and late check-out waivers according to Aurelle Revenue Management standards.
Identify and escalate injuries, Severity 1 incidents, and complete incident reports within required timeframes.

content.activity: Acknowledge and comply with loaded rate requirements prohibiting manual rate creation.
Acknowledge the 15-minute injury reporting rule to the Manager on Duty.
Review end-of-shift Incident Report completion standards for Severity 1 and 2 incidents.

content.description: Demonstrate understanding of injury reporting timelines by outlining the exact steps and timeframe required when a guest or employee is injured.
content.expected_outcome: A clear understanding that any injury must be reported to the Manager on Duty within 15 minutes.
content.completion_criteria: Successfully document the reporting workflow adhering to the 15-minute rule.

content.situation: A corporate client requests a special group rate that is 20% below the published rate, and a guest reports minor slip-and-fall injuries in the lobby.
expected_actions: Recognize that rate overrides above 15% require an approval code from the Duty Manager or a Revenue Analyst.
Ensure the injury is reported to the Manager on Duty within 15 minutes.

content.question: Who is permitted to create rates in the PMS?
content.explanation: Only rates loaded in the PMS by Revenue Management may be offered to guests; manual rate creation is prohibited.

options: An email confirmation from the General Manager
An approval code from the Duty Manager or a Revenue Analyst
Written agreement signed by the client only
No special approval is needed if it is corporate business
content.question: What is required for rate overrides above 15% of the published rate?
content.explanation: Rate overrides above 15% of the published rate require an approval code from the Duty Manager or a Revenue Analyst.

content.question: Late check-out fees may be waived by any department team member as long as it is noted in an email.
content.explanation: Late check-out fees may be waived only by the Duty Manager, and the reason for the waiver must be recorded in the PMS.

options: Before the end of the shift
content.question: Within what timeframe must any injury to a guest or employee be reported to the Manager on Duty (MOD)?
content.explanation: Any injury to a guest or employee must be reported to the Manager on Duty (MOD) within 15 minutes.

content.question: The Duty Manager must notify the General Manager within what timeframe of any Severity 1 incident?
content.explanation: The Duty Manager must notify the General Manager within 30 minutes of any Severity 1 incident, meaning death, serious injury, fire, police involvement or a data breach.

options: Before the end of the shift
content.question: When must the Duty Manager complete the Incident Report in the incident system for all Severity 1 and 2 incidents?
content.explanation: The Duty Manager must complete the Incident Report in the incident system before the end of the shift for all Severity 1 and 2 incidents.

content.topic: Revenue Management and Incident Escalation Policies

rubric.criterion: Loaded Rates and Rate Override Compliance
rubric.pass_condition: Achieves 100% accuracy on rate policy questions.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates full compliance with loaded rates and correctly identifies override approval workflows.

rubric.pass_condition: Identifies correct timelines and reporting steps without error.
rubric.expected_performance: Accurately details notification windows for injuries, Severity 1 incidents, and end-of-shift report requirements.

modules.title: Sales & Events
modules.purpose: To equip Sales & Events Executives with the standard procedures for managing enquiries, group proposals, contracts, deposits, site inspections, and event handovers according to Aurelle standards.
assessment_topics: Sales, Contracts, Proposals, and Event Handover Competency
modules.completion_criteria: Successfully complete all tasks, achieve 80% or higher on the quiz, and pass the practical assessment rubric.

content.text: Record all group and event bookings in the Sales & Catering system and apply displacement analysis for large groups.
Execute contract management, secure non-refundable deposits, and prepare complete group proposals according to company templates.
Coordinate banquet event orders, site inspections, account targets, and event handovers with operations.

content.activity: Hand over each confirmed event to the Events Operations team at least 14 days before the event

content.description: Prepare a complete group proposal for a prospective client booking 15 rooms, ensuring it includes the applicable rate, a 30% deposit schedule, and standard cancellation terms.
content.expected_outcome: A fully compliant group proposal document generated and verified.
content.completion_criteria: Proposal contains rate, correct deposit schedule, cancellation terms, and passed displacement calculator evaluation.

content.situation: You receive an enquiry for a group block requesting 12 rooms per night. Before quoting the client, you must follow the correct evaluation procedure.
expected_actions: Recognize that group quotes above 10 rooms per night require evaluation with the displacement calculator.
Run the displacement analysis before offering the quote to the client.

content.question: Within what timeframe must all group and event bookings be recorded in the Sales & Catering system?
content.explanation: All group and event bookings must be recorded in the Sales & Catering system within 24 hours of the enquiry.

content.question: Who must approve any changes to cancellation or payment clauses in a contract?
content.explanation: Contracts must use the approved Aurelle template; any change to cancellation or payment clauses requires Director of Sales approval.

options: A refundable deposit of 10% within 7 days
A non-refundable deposit of 30% of the total contract value within 14 days of signature
A non-refundable deposit of 50% within 30 days
No deposit is required for signed contracts
content.question: What is the requirement for securing group bookings with a deposit?
content.explanation: Group bookings must be secured with a non-refundable deposit of 30% of the total contract value within 14 days of signature.

options: At least 3 days before the event
At least 7 days before the event
At least 14 days before the event
On the day of the event
content.question: When must Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) be issued to all operating departments?
content.explanation: Banquet Event Orders must be issued to all operating departments at least 7 days before the event.

content.question: Group quotes above 10 rooms per night must be evaluated with the displacement calculator before being offered.
content.explanation: Group quotes above 10 rooms per night must be evaluated with the displacement calculator before being offered.

options: At least 7 days before the event
At least 10 days before the event
At least 14 days before the event
At least 30 days before the event
content.question: How far in advance must Sales & Events Executives hand over each confirmed event to the Events Operations team?
content.explanation: Sales & Events Executives must hand over each confirmed event to the Events Operations team at least 14 days before the event.

content.topic: Sales, Contracts, Proposals, and Event Handover Competency

rubric.pass_condition: Successfully demonstrates system entry and displacement evaluation without errors.
rubric.expected_performance: Accurately records enquiries within 24 hours and correctly runs displacement calculator for group blocks above 10 rooms.

rubric.pass_condition: Proposal includes all mandatory elements and appropriate Director of Sales approvals where required.
rubric.expected_performance: Prepares complete proposals with correct deposit and cancellation terms, adhering to template and approval rules.

rubric.pass_condition: Timelines for BEO issuance and event handover are strictly met.
rubric.expected_performance: Issues BEOs 7 days prior and completes event handovers to Operations 14 days prior.

rubric.pass_condition: Demonstrates clear understanding of market segment responsibilities and quota adherence.
rubric.expected_performance: Shows competence in managing assigned market segment accounts and targeting quarterly revenue goals.

modules.title: Workplace Conduct
modules.purpose: To ensure intermediate employees understand and adhere to Aurelle Hotels & Residences standards regarding professional conduct, uniform, gift limits, anti-harassment, social media privacy, conflict of interest declarations, media escalation, and break locations.
key_concepts: Break locations away from guest areas
modules.completion_criteria: Successful completion of all checklist items, submission of written disclosures where applicable, and achieving a passing grade on the knowledge assessment.

content.text: Comply with Aurelle standards on workplace conduct, professional appearance, and the Code of Conduct declaration.
Identify and appropriately report harassment, discrimination, gift declarations, and conflicts of interest.
Maintain guest privacy on social media and correctly escalate media enquiries.

content.activity: Sign the Code of Conduct declaration before your first shift
Acknowledge anti-harassment, discrimination, and bullying reporting procedures
Acknowledge restrictions on posting guest or back-of-house photos online
Acknowledge media enquiry referral protocols to the Communications team
Acknowledge break policy requiring breaks to be taken away from guest areas

content.description: Submit any applicable conflict of interest disclosures (such as family relationships with suppliers) in writing to Human Resources.
content.expected_outcome: A written declaration submitted to HR if any conflict of interest exists.
content.completion_criteria: Written conflict of interest declaration submitted and acknowledged by HR within the first week (W1).

content.description: Review gift limit guidelines and complete a mock gift declaration form for a gift received from a guest valued above USD 25.
content.expected_outcome: Correctly identifying a gift requiring declaration and reporting it to the Duty Manager within 24 hours.
content.completion_criteria: Gift declaration form accurately prepared and submitted to the Duty Manager within the required 24-hour timeframe.

content.situation: A journalist approaches you in the hotel lobby asking about a security incident that occurred overnight, and a VIP guest offers you a personalized luxury watch worth USD 150 as a token of appreciation.
expected_actions: Politely decline to answer any questions from the journalist and refer all enquiries immediately to the Communications team.
Recognize that the luxury watch exceeds the USD 25 unsolicited gift limit.
Declare the gift above USD 25 to the Duty Manager within 24 hours.

content.question: All employees must sign the Code of Conduct declaration before their first shift.
content.explanation: All employees must sign the Code of Conduct declaration before their first shift as specified in COC-01 [§1.3].

content.question: What is the maximum value for unsolicited gifts from guests that employees may accept without declaring them?
content.explanation: Employees may accept unsolicited gifts from guests up to a value of USD 25; any gift above this value must be declared to the Duty Manager within 24 hours [COC-01 §3.2].

content.question: Who must receive a declaration in writing regarding conflicts of interest, such as family relationships with suppliers?
content.explanation: Conflicts of interest, including family relationships with suppliers, must be declared to Human Resources in writing [COC-01 §6.3].

options: Answer questions transparently to maintain public relations
Refer all enquiries to the Communications team
Ask the Duty Manager to speak on camera
content.question: What must an employee do if approached by the media regarding an incident at the hotel?
content.explanation: Employees must not speak to the media about any incident and must refer all enquiries to the Communications team [ESC-01 §4.1].

content.question: Employees are permitted to post photographs of guest rooms on their personal social media accounts.
content.explanation: Employees must not post photographs of guests, guest rooms or back-of-house areas on personal social media [COC-01 §5.1].

options: At guest dining tables during off-peak hours
content.question: Where should employees take their breaks according to informal guidance reminders?
content.explanation: Please remind your teams to take their breaks away from guest areas [MEM-01 para 4].

rubric.pass_condition: Accurately answers questions and completes practical tasks regarding declarations.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly identifies requirements for signing the declaration and declaring conflicts of interest and gifts.

rubric.pass_condition: Correctly states and applies escalation procedures without breaches.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates full adherence to uniform, social media privacy rules, and media referral protocols.

rubric.pass_condition: Scores 80% or higher on scenario evaluations and quiz items.
rubric.expected_performance: Applies reporting channels for harassment and adheres to break and conduct policies.

modules.title: Finance Operations and 3 related areas
modules.purpose: To equip employees with core operational knowledge regarding finance procedures, health and safety protocols, compliance training standards, and guest inquiry guidelines.
modules.completion_criteria: Complete all required reading, successfully finish tasks and scenarios, and pass the e-learning assessment with a minimum score of 80% within 30 days of joining.

content.text: Apply finance procedures correctly regarding purchase orders, invoice matching, city ledger credit limits, and expense claim deadlines.
Adhere to health, safety, and compliance training standards including heavy load handling and assessment passing criteria.
Consult appropriate policies when handling guest inquiries such as pet stays.

content.activity: Submit expense claims with original receipts within 30 days of the expense

content.description: Review a set of mock purchase requisitions and supplier invoices to verify compliance with purchase order thresholds and three-way match requirements.
content.expected_outcome: Accurately identify which purchases require an approved PO and verify that supplier invoices match the PO and goods received note.
content.completion_criteria: Successfully process 3 mock procurement verification cases without error.

content.situation: You are organizing a large event portfolio and need to move a heavy display box weighing 24 kg into the sales suite.
expected_actions: Recognize that the load exceeds 20 kg
Arrange for a second person to help lift the load or use a trolley

content.question: What is the threshold above which purchases require an approved Purchase Order before placing the order with the supplier?
content.explanation: Purchases above USD 1,000 require an approved Purchase Order before the order is placed with the supplier.

options: The departmental budget and manager approval
The Purchase Order and the goods received note
The bank statement and tax receipt
The sales contract and delivery slip
content.question: To what must supplier invoices be matched before payment?
content.explanation: Supplier invoices must be matched to the Purchase Order and the goods received note before payment.

content.question: Who must approve city ledger credit above USD 5,000 per account before the account is activated?
content.explanation: City ledger credit above USD 5,000 per account must be approved by the Finance Manager before the account is activated.

content.question: What is the maximum timeframe for submitting expense claims with original receipts?
content.explanation: Expense claims must be submitted with original receipts within 30 days of the expense.

options: Lifted quickly by a single person
Lifted by two people or moved with a trolley
Split into smaller parts regardless of quantity
content.question: How should loads heavier than 20 kg be handled according to safety guidelines?
content.explanation: Loads heavier than 20 kg must be lifted by two people or moved with a trolley.

options: Ask the guest to keep the pet outside
Allow the pet for a daily fee
content.question: What action must be taken if you are unsure whether a guest's pet can stay?
content.explanation: If you are unsure whether a guest's pet can stay, check the Pet Policy (PET-01).

rubric.criterion: Understanding of Finance Procedures and Thresholds
rubric.pass_condition: Achieve at least 80% on the overall assessment within 30 days.
rubric.expected_performance: Accurately answers questions and executes tasks related to purchase orders, three-way matching, city ledger limits, and expense deadlines.

rubric.criterion: Adherence to Safety and Compliance Guidelines
rubric.pass_condition: Achieve at least 80% on the overall assessment within 30 days.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates correct knowledge of heavy lifting protocols, compliance e-learning pass marks, and policy consultation requirements.
